technique_name: Please describe why there is a lack of adequate nutrition in developing countries.
description: In developing countries, there is a lack of adequate nutrition due to a variety of factors. Poor infrastructure, lack of access to affordable nutritious food , and limited knowledge of proper nutrition are major contributing factors. Poor infrastructure often means that people lack access to public transportation to get to stores which sell nutritious food; or where people can get proper medical care for illnesses related to poor nutrition.
